Team —

Quick pulse ahead of next week’s QBR prep cycle. TL;DR: product is stable, a latency regression cropped up on Dedicated this week, and we have two asks (procurement support + runway for a small hiring request). Details below.

WINS
- Hosted API availability: 99.98% (week) — minor routing flaps but fallbacks held.
- Redwood Optimize pilot (Beta) completed for three customers; preliminary cost savings ~18% on token spend.
- Successful RSVPs for May 21 partner meetup (20+ integrations committed).

RISKS / OPEN ISSUES
- Dedicated latency regression: p95 increased from 210ms -> 380ms for seq-length >1024 workloads after kernel tweak deployed 2026-05-01. Engineering has a mitigation path (rollback + selective kernel toggle) but this could impact SLAs if not fully mitigated by EOD Wednesday.
  - Initial impact: two medium-size customers saw 5–8% increase in tail latency; support is engaged.
  - Data attached: [Attachment: latency-snapshot-0506.csv].

ASKS (action requested)
1) Procurement support to expedite FortifyCloud PO approval (they want a revised SOW/term showing private deployment start date). Point person: Laura — can you help expedite? Related contact: procurement@fortifycloud.com
2) Exec sign-off for one IC headcount (inference infra SWE, 6-month backfill + product velocity case). I’ll circulate the hiring memo if you want more detail.

ACTIONS IN PROGRESS
- Infra: Markus is running a selective rollback plan and a telemetry sweep to validate cache behavior.
- CS: Maya is coordinating impacted customers and drafting outage communications if SLA risk persists.
- Eng Ops: Jonas will prioritize the smoke test matrix for seq >1024.

Attachments: QBR_one-pager.pdf (one-pager for ops highlights), latency-snapshot-0506.csv
Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QBR_ONE_PAGER

Thanks — will post updates in this thread as we get validation.

— Soojin

Forwarding quick technical note + proposed mitigation.

----- Forwarded message from Markus Klein -----
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated latency regression — immediate mitigation plan
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Summary: root cause appears to be an aggressive kernel selection that changed memory access patterns for long sequences. Rollback plan: revert kernel selector for affected cluster (K-4) and enable an opt-in quantized path for >1024 seq. Expected timeline: rollback + validation ~4–6 hours; full verification across zones 24 hours.

Customer impact: AcmeAI (Ellis Tran) and FortifyCloud reported increased tail. CS scripts are in place to toggle degraded customers to Hosted fallback automatically.

Requesting:
- Approval to run rollback during the low-traffic window Wednesday 03:00–07:00 PDT (minimal customer traffic)
- Permission to offer a 5% service credit to customers impacted if SLAs are missed (I’ll follow up with Finance on cost).

Attachment: latency-snapshot-0506.csv

----- End forwarded message -----

I’ll prepare the one-paragraph bulletin for Sales/CS and will post by EOD Tuesday as requested.

-Markus
